#!/bin/bash
# 下载 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 模型（从 ModelScope）
# 用法: bash download_qwen.sh
# 模型将下载到数据盘，并创建 symlink 到项目目录
set -e

MODEL_ID="Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct"
DOWNLOAD_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/streamprobe/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct"
LINK_DIR="/root/streamprobe/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct"
REQUIRED_SPACE_GB=20

echo "=== 下载 ${MODEL_ID} ==="

# 激活 conda 环境
if [ -f /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh ]; then
    source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
elif [ -f /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh ]; then
    source /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
fi
conda activate streamprobe 2>/dev/null || conda activate base

# 安装 modelscope
if ! python -c "import modelscope" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "安装 modelscope..."
    pip install modelscope -q
fi

# 磁盘空间预检
AVAIL_GB=$(df /root/autodl-tmp --output=avail -BG | tail -1 | tr -d ' G')
if [ "$AVAIL_GB" -lt "$REQUIRED_SPACE_GB" ]; then
    echo "错误: 数据盘可用空间 ${AVAIL_GB}GB，需要至少 ${REQUIRED_SPACE_GB}GB"
    exit 1
fi
echo "数据盘可用空间: ${AVAIL_GB}GB (需要 ${REQUIRED_SPACE_GB}GB)"

# 创建目标目录
mkdir -p "$DOWNLOAD_DIR"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LINK_DIR")"

# 下载模型
echo "开始下载到 ${DOWNLOAD_DIR} ..."
python -c "
from modelscope import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('${MODEL_ID}', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/streamprobe/models', revision='master')
"

# 下载验证
echo "验证下载文件..."
MISSING=0
for f in config.json tokenizer.json tokenizer_config.json generation_config.json; do
    if [ ! -f "${DOWNLOAD_DIR}/${f}" ]; then
        echo "缺失: ${f}"
        MISSING=1
    fi
done

SAFETENSOR_COUNT=$(find "$DOWNLOAD_DIR" -name "*.safetensors" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
if [ "$SAFETENSOR_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "缺失: safetensors 模型权重文件"
    MISSING=1
else
    echo "找到 ${SAFETENSOR_COUNT} 个 safetensors 文件"
fi

if [ "$MISSING" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "错误: 下载不完整，请重新执行"
    exit 1
fi

# 创建 symlink
if [ -L "$LINK_DIR" ]; then
    rm "$LINK_DIR"
fi
ln -s "$DOWNLOAD_DIR" "$LINK_DIR"
echo "已创建 symlink: ${LINK_DIR} -> ${DOWNLOAD_DIR}"

echo "=== 下载完成 ==="
ls -lh "$DOWNLOAD_DIR"
